title: Solidroad, which uses AI to evaluate customer interactions with human and AI agents to find risk, skill gaps, and more, raised a $25M Series A led by Hedosophia (Paul Gillin/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Paul Gillin / SiliconANGLE: Solidroad, which uses AI to evaluate customer interactions with human and AI agents to find risk, skill gaps, and more, raised a $25M Series A led by Hedosophia — Solidroad Inc., a startup that develops software for use in training and coaching customer service agents, today said it has raised $25 million in an early-stage fundin…
